text.aria-label: Title text 'One week of data fixes capacity only to within a few tenths of a megawatt'

g.text: One week of data fixes capacity only to within a few tenths of a megawatt

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each week is fitted alone by least squares: power on a constant, a weekend indicator, temperature, three daily harmonics, and minus the CAMS solar shape (peak 1). The coefficient on the shape is the week's capacity in MW. Standard errors are the classical ones, so they understate the real uncertainty; blank cells are months with no observed week. 8 Primary substations, 2019 to 2026.'
text.tspan: Each week is fitted alone by least squares: power on a constant, a weekend indicator,
temperature, three daily harmonics, and minus the CAMS solar shape (peak 1). The
coefficient on the shape is the week's capacity in MW.
Standard errors are the classical ones, so they understate the real uncertainty; blank
cells are months with no observed week. 8 Primary substations, 2019 to 2026.
